subject: Approval request — ClipperHealth onboarding bundle + premium support concession
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@clipperhealth.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@clipperhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal + support bundle — request for deal-desk approval

Hi Daniel / Clipper procurement — and team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Clipper is targeting a pilot start in late July and the scope the customer needs includes:
- Redwood Hosted inference (standard model) for 3 product teams
- Premium Onboarding: 80 hours of dedicated engineering time (remote) + 2 onsite days for connector integration
- Premium Support (Priority 24x7) for first 12 months as part of the launch bundle

Clipper has asked for a commercial concession to make the economics work for the pilot. We modeled two options in the attached SOW and discount workbook:
- Option A: 18% one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice, includes the premium support bundle (12 months) and the onsite days
- Option B: 12% one-time credit + additional rate card credit for extra onboarding hours beyond the 80 included

We think Option A is the simplest path to close quickly, but it exceeds our standard discount matrix (sales + deal desk flagged it). I’m escalating for exec approval because:
1) Premium support + onsite integration is above the typical bundled allowance for this tier
2) Customer is requesting 60-day invoicing terms and a guaranteed go-live date (we need to limit SLA exposure)

Attachments: SOW_Clipper_v3.pdf, discount_calc_Clipper.xlsx, onboarding_schedule.xlsx

Request for leadership: executive approval to offer Option A (18% onboarding credit + 12 months premium support) with the following conditions:
- Cap support credits at $45k lifetime;
- Payment terms: Net 45 (no changes to revenue recognition beyond Net 45) ;
- Legal to finalize a short MSA amendment and DocuSign before any credit is applied.

Jonas / Marissa / Ben — quick thoughts on risk (cost / implementation) appreciated so I can present to Rafael for sign-off.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@clipperhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jun 2028 11:02:41 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal + support bundle — request for deal-desk approval

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side:
1) The onsite work: two days onsite — is travel included in the price/credit or billed separately?
2) The 12-month premium support — can that be reduced to 9 months as a concession if we commit to a 12-month paid renewal afterwards?
3) Procurement needs the SOW and an itemized cost table; they asked whether we can get this over today so they can prep the PO.

Our goal is a firm PO by 6/20 so we can start onboarding 7/15. If you need any flexibility on the dates we can discuss.

Regards,
Daniel Reed
Director, Product Ops | ClipperHealth
daniel.reed@clipperhealth.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 08:47:12 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal + support bundle — request for deal-desk approval

Sofia — quick evaluation from delivery side:
- 80 remote hours + 2 onsite days is feasible but will need a dedicated solutions lead + JE to accelerate connectors (we currently estimate actual cost at ~$62k for delivery resources).
- If we go Option A (18%), delivery cost will consume most of the credit. We should avoid setting a precedent that the onboarding credit covers post-launch support burn.
- Recommend: approve Option A only if we
  a) cap total refundable credit at $45k (as you suggested), and
  b) require Clipper to accept a deployment acceptance sign-off after the pilot.

Also: travel (hotel/airfare) should be billed pass-through; mark it explicitly in the SOW.

If leadership wants to be more conservative, Option B (12% + hourly overage) is safer.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 09:22:05 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal + support bundle — request for deal-desk approval

Rafael + Sofia — I endorse a controlled concession here. Context: Clipper is a small but strategically valuable customer in the payer integration space; closing quickly helps us build a reference for health domain connectors.

Proposed final terms from sales/finance POV:
- One-time onboarding credit: 15% (reduce ask to split the difference)
- Premium support: include 9 months as part of bundle, with an option to renew at standard seat rates at renewal
- Travel billed pass-through
- Cap total support-related credit exposure at $40k
- Require DocuSign SOW + updated MSA amendment and Net 45 payment terms

If Rafael signs off we can present this to Clipper as a limited, one-time concession (expires 6/18).

Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Exec sign-off needed for ClipperHealth bundle (timing sensitive)

Hi Rafael — looping you in for final approval. Summary below:
- Customer: ClipperHealth (pilot target 7/15)
- Ask: one-time onboarding credit + premium support bundled for go-live
- Sales recommended terms (Marissa): 15% credit, include 9 months premium support, cap $40k, travel billed pass-through, Net 45
- Delivery note (Jonas): delivery actuals ~ $62k, acceptance sign-off required, travel pass-through
- Procurement: needs itemized SOW for PO by EOD 6/12

Attachments: SOW_Clipper_v3.pdf, discount_calc_Clipper.xlsx

Request: Rafael, please confirm by EOD whether we can proceed with Marissa's proposal and authorize Legal to issue an MSA amendment/DocuSign link. If approved, I'll send a formal offer to Clipper and loop legal/finance.

Thanks — Sofia

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: ClipperHealth onboarding concession (conditions attached)

Team — thanks for the concise package. I approve Marissa's recommendation with the following binding conditions:
1) Final concession is 15% one-time onboarding credit; cap support-related exposure at $40k (no exceptions).
2) Premium support included for 9 months only; any extension must be billed at standard rates and approved by Sales Ops.
3) Travel is pass-through; itemize travel in the SOW.
4) Payment terms: Net 45 as requested, but Finance must confirm credit memo handling before any credit is applied.
5) Legal to prepare a short MSA amendment and DocuSign; no credits to be invoiced/recognized until executed.
6) We will include a clause that this is a one-time concession and explicitly non-precedential.

Sofia — you have authorization to present these terms to Clipper and to send the DocuSign link once Legal confirms the amendment. Please loop in Finance (Ben) on the payment/credit flow.

Rafael Mendes
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

-- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/clipper-msa-DSIGN
